resolution: FIXED — resolved only when an approving fingerprinted independent review lists it in verified_findings

resolution: FIXED — resolved only when an approving fingerprinted independent review lists it in verified_findings

Action predicates can be trivially true
Consecutive-run gate measured within one invocation
Testing doc contradicted the code
Soak hash timing and summary trust
Inert fault hook in release builds
Review record not bound to the candidate commit
Granted app's own non-standard file UI can act within the app's capability (app-scoped grants)
Findings could change after review without re-review

summary: T-REL-09 lacked recorded independent reproduction
T-MAC-05 did not cross applications
Live harness duplicated executor retry policy
Debug logging, duplication, typing and module-size smells
Reviews were not bound to the built artifact or acceptance results; source read from the working tree
Surface classification failed open for file dialogs without the known markers (standalone Open panel in list/icon view) and for truncated AX walks
T-REL-09 recorded counts instead of scenario IDs; independence was self-declared by the tool
T-MAC-05 used one fixture app and only token input
Token-binding safety was proven only against the fake driver; panel input was not re-classified
Standards: duplicated git/hash/flag helpers, untyped retry and predicates, repeated action lists, pass-through helpers, two names for the panel service
Two-walk race: observation classified one AX walk but issued tokens from a second, so a sheet attaching in between could receive token input without file_panel_input
File-dialog detection relied on English labels and failed open in other system languages
Release gate judged findings from results.findings, not the fingerprinted register; qualify silently assumed an empty register
reproduce.ts could never reproduce T-BOOT-02 (FAULT), so no review could ever approve
`fs.copy` and `fs.move` never authorize the source path
`fs.trash` accepts an unauthorized, model-supplied `trash_dir`
An exception from `verify` strands attempts and aborts the whole startup recovery
Planner-supplied postconditions act as an arbitrary-file read oracle
`api.send_message` follows HTTP redirects past destination policy
Target resolution touches the filesystem before authorization (existence oracle and pre-auth DoS)
Redaction misses common credential shapes and the `Authorization: Bearer` form
Notification dedup key embeds raw, unredacted text and silently drops distinct notifications
Broker caller authentication is self-asserted for `core:<task_id>`
Non-idempotent dedup and provider idempotency depend on planner-chosen `step_key` and exact args
File contents read via `fs.read` are persisted in the DB and replayed to the planner
Stop cannot cancel in-flight work: the adapter AbortSignal is never wired
Tasks in VERIFYING or RECONCILING are not paused by Stop and resume without explicit owner resume
Re-putting a revoked grant silently re-activates it (and all tasks bound to it)
Case-variant paths on APFS bypass claims and semantic dedup
Daily budget loses a reservation that spans UTC midnight
HTTP 429 is a permanent, non-retryable failure
Outbox has no status compare-and-set, so concurrent `deliverDue` double-sends
`fs.write` replace mode widens permissions of the replaced file; temp files are 0644 and leak on crash
Partial multi-step file effects are recorded as PROVEN_NOT_APPLIED
WAIT_RESOURCE leaves a dead waiter at the head of the claim queue, blocking that resource until restart
A model could complete a zero-action task by declaring, on its done turn, a criterion that was already true (A-05: action evidence vs the owner's goal)
resolution: FIXED: done-turn criteria never freeze; completion needs an earned evidence strength (owner criteria, a frozen criterion false before the first effect and true now, or a read-only observation of this revision) (0276fa3)

summary: fs.write/fs.copy/fs.move followed a symlink swapped in after the checks (link()/copyfile() follow links), giving a workspace name to a file outside the grant
resolution: FIXED: no-follow descriptors, inode and parent-identity check after publish, undo on mismatch (92b4b80)

summary: Background members of a sandboxed process group outlived a leader that exited normally (escaping timeout, Stop and the journal); a pipe holder hung the run
resolution: FIXED: group killed when the leader exits; bounded wait for pipe close (setsid escape remains, A-46) (cf8ec31)

summary: Resource waiters kept stale per-key queue positions, so two tasks could each head a queue the other needed (deadlock)
resolution: FIXED: one ticket per waiter across all keys; abandoned keys dropped (71b0306)

summary: Pause, cancel or revise during completion verification still completed or failed the task and sent a false 'Done' notice
resolution: FIXED: verification result dropped unless the task is still VERIFYING the same revision and generation; notices only for real transitions (da759ff)

summary: Graceful stop orphaned the private Cua driver, and socket names restarted at cua-1.sock, so a surviving driver enforcing an older grant's manifest could be reused
resolution: FIXED: awaited bounded shutdown, per-launch socket/manifest names, startup retirement of stale drivers (279536b)

summary: Focus-routed input (keys, focused typing, menus) could reach a file-panel sheet in another window of the same app; Finder list views classified as ordinary windows
resolution: FIXED: every window of the app is classified before focus-routed input; Finder is always a file-panel surface. Real-driver routing behaviour not live-verified (GUI tests deferred) (4c13e8b)

summary: Reviewer identity was free text (an implementer could write an approving review) and reproduction logs were fingerprinted but never parsed
resolution: FIXED: SSH signature from the owner's allowed-signers file (outside the repo) required; evaluator re-derives counts, scenario IDs and commit from each log (bd9bd3b)

summary: An empty or truncated API token file made the local API accept an empty or missing bearer
resolution: FIXED: tokens under 32 characters are replaced and never match (e4c2679)

summary: After an owner revision the model could never act again (effects of the old revision blocked freezing criteria)
resolution: FIXED: only effects of the current revision count (0276fa3)

summary: Deterministic provider 4xx errors were retried on every availability wake
Resume skipped the dependency gate; revise un-paused; restart never woke resource waiters or tasks left RECOVERING; daily budget waits never woke
Phone /stop could be rate limited; Telegram notices with lost outcomes were dropped; unknown outcomes and lookup errors were unbounded or stalled delivery
A corrupt store made launchd restart the daemon every 10 s without recording an incident
resolution: FIXED: quarantine at startup, clean exit, KeepAlive SuccessfulExit=false (e4c2679)

summary: web.fetch missed mapped/compatible IPv6, CGNAT and other non-public ranges and re-resolved DNS at connect time (rebinding)
resolution: FIXED: BlockList classifier, connections pinned to vetted answers (3e118a5)

summary: An accepted (2xx) message send whose lookup lagged was FAILED, inviting a duplicate under a new key; response bodies uncapped
resolution: FIXED: inconclusive -> keyed reconciliation; 64 KiB cap (61c1905)

summary: Children kept running after their parent was paused or failed
Non-streaming provider calls timed out at 120 s for 16k-token turns (billed, retried)
resolution: FIXED: streamed, 10-minute ceiling (offline SSE test only; no live provider run) (aad5f33)

summary: Untrusted tool output could close the prompt's untrusted fence; memory reached the provider unredacted
Review history was not ancestry-checked; an uncommitted reviews.json made the tree dirty
The driver pin did not validate the bundle seal (only the executable digest)
Workspace claim keys were case-sensitive on case-insensitive volumes
Packaged builds were always CFBundleVersion 1; notices ran from the working tree
Any settings save cleared the provider's retry-after backoff
A sandboxed process that calls setsid leaves the owned group and survives Stop/timeout (macOS has no subreaper)
resolution: ACCEPTED residual: the run no longer hangs on it; the escapee is not killed (cf8ec31)

summary: Claims are not hierarchical: a proc.run workspace claim does not conflict with fs path claims inside that workspace
Refusal-fallback reservation does not cover multi-model iterations (latent: fallback is disabled in the daemon)
Byte-reproducible packaging is unproven
